messages:
rachel: Heads up — preflight shows a small 429 spike on /v2/stream in staging with long-lived clients. Thinking we should delay the eu-west rollout by 2h to add an SDK reconnect/backoff note and run a pin-export for high-concurrency tenants.

deploybot: @channel scheduled v2 rollout (eu-west) at 2026-03-21T16:00Z. Preflight: HEALTH=pass, CANARY=pass, RATE=warn.

sam: paste the 429 sample pls? client bug or our cap?
rachel: staging log: ``ERROR req=abc123 status=429 route=/v2/stream token=tenant-42 dur=00:12:03`` — correlates with concurrent-stream cap per tenant.

anya: If it's our concurrent limit, addendum + temporary burst increase for affected dedicated tenants makes sense. ops needs tenant list.
mike: can we export pins now? need exact tenants to tell CS.
tariq: kicking off pin export now.

ops-bot: export job started (exp-754321-01). ETA ~40s.
rachel: If >5 tenants show high streaming, delay 2h. Otherwise proceed but include note.
deploybot: note: can proceed or delay up to 3h by operator command.

ops-bot: export complete. CSV: //internal/exports/v2-pin-export-7543210000.csv — 7 tenants with >10 concurrent streams.
sam: 7 > threshold. Recommend delay 2h and prepare SDK snippet:
```
// pseudo
onDisconnect() {
  await sleep(expBackoff(250ms, maxRetries=6) + jitter())
  tryReconnect()
}
```

anya: I'll draft the addendum + migration FAQ.
mike: ops, how fast to bump per-tenant burst caps? runbook link?
tariq: We have a reversible patch to +20 concurrent streams per tenant for eu-west. Prep ~20m. low risk.

rachel: Plan: delay rollout to 18:00Z, ops apply temp patch before resume, anya posts addendum, sam prepares snippet, I'll update tenants and releasebot. Any objections?
mike: no objections. :thumbsup:
tariq: starting patch prep, will report when applied.
deploybot: action recorded: rollout delayed by operator rachel until 2026-03-21T18:00Z. Reply `proceed` to resume earlier.

ops-bot: patch applied (patch_id=patch-754321-eu): per-tenant concurrent-stream cap +20. Monitoring for 10m.
mike: metrics look stable in the patch window.

anya: addendum draft posted to //internal/docs/release-notes/v2-addendum-754321.md — includes SDK snippet and FAQ.
sam: added streaming reconnection note to migration checklist.
rachel: thanks — I'll attach the CSV and comms to CS and we resume at 18:00Z. :raised_hands:
